entities.name: Diphosphomevalonate decarboxylase P32377
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed Saccharomyces cerevisiae UniProt P32377, EC 4.1.1.33.
Catalyzes (R)-5-diphosphomevalonate + ATP = isopentenyl diphosphate + ADP + CO2 + phosphate (Rhea:23732).
Functions in mevalonate-pathway isopentenyl diphosphate biosynthesis; reference annotation names MVD1/ERG19.

entities.name: RHEA:23732
observations: Diphosphomevalonate decarboxylation coupled to ATP hydrolysis: (R)-5-diphosphomevalonate + ATP = isopentenyl diphosphate + ADP + CO2 + phosphate.
